outcome: length of antenatal inpatient hospital stay
length of adult special care unit stay
cohort: The study included 98 women with type one diabetes referred to a state-wide tertiary obstetric centre in Australia, propensity matched between those using CGM and those using SMBG.
finding: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) use in women with type one diabetes during pregnancy significantly reduced pre-term and very pre-term birth rates, decreased lengths of various hospital stays, and represented a net cost saving to the health care sector.
